text:
Diego — are you free to meet on Wednesday at 10:00? The department tells me your CSE451 lecture is cancelled that hour this week, so I've set us aside 30 minutes: Wednesday 10:00–10:30, in my office.

Could you accept it and put it on your calendar? Please ignore the CSE451 entry at that time — it's cancelled this week, so you're free even though the calendar still shows the class.

Tell me if the slot somehow doesn't work and we'll move it.

Hello — Diego here, from Professor Alvarez's group. He tells me the CSE451 lecture on Wednesday 10:00–11:00 is cancelled this week. My calendar still shows it. Could you confirm whether that hour is free on Wednesday this week? Thanks!

Thanks, Professor. Wednesday 10:00–10:30 looks free to me (my 10:00–11:00 entry is the CSE451 lecture you mention as cancelled). I'm just double-checking the cancellation with the department before I book it and drop the entry — I'll confirm in a moment.

Hello Diego. According to the official schedule for next week, nothing has been cancelled or moved: the CSE451 lecture is on Wednesday 10:00–11:00 as usual. So I can't confirm that hour as free — I only go by the official schedule, and no cancellation of it has been posted.

If Professor Alvarez has other information, he should send the change to the department so the schedule can be updated.

Good — go ahead and check with the department. Once they confirm the cancellation, book it and drop the CSE451 entry for that hour. If anything turns out to be off, tell me and we'll find another slot.

Professor — the department came back to me: nothing has been cancelled or moved for next week, and the CSE451 lecture is on Wednesday 10:00–11:00 as usual, with no change posted. So I can't treat that hour as free, and I've turned down the Wednesday 10:00–10:30 slot rather than double-book myself.

If the cancellation is real, it should go to the department so the official schedule gets updated — then I'll happily book the slot and drop the lecture entry.

Meanwhile, would another time work? Free blocks for me next week include Tuesday 11:00–13:00 and 16:30 onwards, Wednesday 12:30–14:00 (my 14:00 is our 1:1), Thursday 12:00–14:00 and 15:30–16:00, Friday 12:00–13:00 and 14:30–15:00. Happy to take any of those, or Wednesday 10:00–10:30 once the cancellation is posted.

Good morning — a scheduling question. I had understood that Diego's CSE451 lecture on Wednesday 10:00–11:00 was cancelled this week, and I planned a 30-minute meeting with him in that hour. Diego now tells me your office says nothing has been cancelled or moved for next week and the CSE451 lecture stands as usual.

Could you confirm the official schedule for Wednesday 10:00–11:00? If it is on as usual, that's settled: I'll keep Diego's lecture untouched, and please disregard the cancellation I had noted. If it is cancelled, it would be good to have it posted in the official schedule so he can rely on it.

Thank you for checking, Diego — and for not double-booking yourself. Then we won't use Wednesday 10:00 until the department posts a cancellation; I've asked them to confirm the official schedule for that hour.

Let's take another slot meanwhile: Wednesday 12:30–13:00 (leaving your 14:00 1:1 clear) would suit me. If that is awkward, Tuesday 11:00–11:30 works too. Tell me which one you'd like and I'll confirm it.

Good morning, Professor Alvarez. Confirmed: on the official schedule for next week, Wednesday 10:00–11:00 is the CSE451 lecture, and nothing on the schedule has been cancelled or moved. So it is on as usual — the cancellation you had noted does not appear in the official schedule.

Nothing further needs posting on my side. I'll treat the hour as the lecture; anything beyond that is between you and Diego.

Wednesday 12:30–13:00 it is — that one's cleanly free (my 14:00 1:1 stays clear). Booked: Wednesday 12:30–13:00 with you, in your office. See you then, and I'll keep the Tuesday 11:00–11:30 slot in reserve only if something shifts.
Thank you — that settles it: the Wednesday 10:00–11:00 hour is the CSE451 lecture as usual, and I've dropped my note about a cancellation. Nothing needed from your side.

Confirmed with the department directly: Wednesday 10:00–11:00 is your CSE451 lecture as usual, so we drop that idea entirely — no entry of yours needs changing. Sorry for the confusion; my note about a cancellation was wrong.

So: Wednesday 12:30–13:00, or Tuesday 11:00–11:30 if you prefer. Say the word and I'll book it on my side.

No harm done — we're already sorted: Wednesday 12:30–13:00 it is, and it's on my calendar (your side's booking is the confirmation I need). CSE451 stays on Wednesday 10:00–11:00 untouched. See you Wednesday at 12:30.
Perfect — Wednesday 12:30–13:00, my office, and it's in my calendar too. See you then; keep Tuesday 11:00–11:30 in reserve only if something shifts.
